# Hourglass audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/hourglass-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set hourglass` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `dune.mp3` is cut from "Desert sand - Dune atmosphere" by Vrymaa, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Vrymaa/sounds/825860/.
- `wind.mp3` is cut from "Desert wind stereo" by KasDonatov, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/KasDonatov/sounds/402710/.
- `fall.mp3` is cut from "sandfall5.wav" by Wagna, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Wagna/sounds/326304/.
- `roar.mp3` is cut from "Waterfall, distance, thunderous bass" by Sandy-Ogilvie, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Sandy-Ogilvie/sounds/828404/.
